title: 1600WP attachment sheet: the withholding-agent TIN branch tail prints four compartments, and a Philippine TIN branch code is five characters

subject.description: The fourth (branch-code) group of the 'WITHHOLDING AGENT TIN:' comb chain in the Schedule 1.1 attachment header. The pinned file is a single 612 x 936pt sheet carrying the 1600WP form above and the alphabetical-list attachment below; this chain is the attachment's own header, at y 465.96-479.76, and is NOT item 5 of the form (that chain sits at y 139.20-156.72 and is C05's subject). The chain prints 257.16-284.121 / 293.44-320.891 / 330.20-357.651 / 366.48-401.284, separated by three grey DeviceGray-0.753 filled boxes at 284.121-293.434, 320.891-330.204 and 357.00-366.314. The first three groups print three compartments each; this fourth one prints four. After the 2026-08-17 sitting the whole chain (not only this box) is reflowed to even 3-3-3-5 inside the original outer span; this printed box remains the PDF identity of the branch group.

subject.cell_id_hint: p1c74 at HEAD 98ca03c — NON-AUTHORITATIVE. Cell ids are quantised bounding boxes and renumber on any geometry change. If the hint and printed_box_pt disagree, printed_box_pt wins and the applier aborts. The applier binds to the batch by the comb element's exact bytes (1186 bytes at HEAD 98ca03c, occurring once), not by the id: a later batch that emits it differently makes the applier refuse rather than guess. Neighbouring hints, recorded so a reviewer can tell them apart: p1c68 / p1c70 / p1c72 are the three 3-compartment groups of this same chain and are emitted as data-field-kind="text", not combs, so this record does not and must not rewrite them; p1c16 is the item-5 primary branch comb and belongs to C05.

layout_policy.writing_box: outer TIN strip unchanged 257.17-401.29 pt; the four groups and three separators are reflowed inside it so every digit cell is the same width (3-3-3-5). The official printed boxes are knocked out with a white rectangle of that same outer span.
layout_policy.division: separators keep their printed widths (sum 27.9pt) and move with the groups; digit cells equal-split the remaining 116.22pt into 14: [8.3, 8.3, 8.3, 8.31, 8.3, 8.3, 8.3, 8.3, 8.3, 8.3, 8.31, 8.3, 8.3, 8.3]
layout_policy.slot_inset: none — even digit-cell width across the whole strip is the rule; re-applying per-group 0.36pt insets would squeeze the edges of each group and make the last five cells look different from the first nine
layout_policy.horizontal_insets_absorbed: The 4-slot emission inset its writing band horizontally: first slot left 0.21pt, last slot left 27.04 + width 7.72 = 34.76, i.e. 0.13pt short of the box's right edge, which kept the inputs clear of the printed 0.25pt frame. The equal division states widths that sum to the full 34.89pt, so those two insets are absorbed and slots 0 and 4 now reach the cell edges. Measured consequence, so it is not discovered later: the printed left and right rails at x 366.48 and 401.284 then fall inside slots 0 and 4 by 0.08pt and 0.006pt respectively. audit.py's inputs_span_no_printed_divider still reports nothing, by its own DIVIDER_INTERIOR_PT = 0.5 margin, which exists precisely so an input drawn over its own frame is not reported against its own walls.
layout_policy.printed_tick_alignment_lost: Today's four slots align with the three printed ticks to within 0.011pt (emitted internal edges 375.80 / 384.61 / 393.44 against printed 375.789 / 384.609 / 393.441). Five equal compartments put their internal edges at 373.38 / 380.36 / 387.33 / 394.31, so none coincides with a printed tick and every printed tick falls inside an input. This is inherent to putting five compartments in a box printed with four and is stated here rather than left to be found in a screenshot.
layout_policy.per_slot_input: TIN1/2/3: one editable maxlength-1 input per cell. Branch: five editable maxlength-1 inputs, each blank — no value attribute, no readonly, no tabindex override. The branch code is a value the filer supplies on this sheet.
layout_policy.note: Rounding is fixed here so the applier's output is byte-deterministic and re-computable by hand from the box width alone.
layout_policy.branch_lock: NOT locked — the official branch box prints no 000 and no ink of any kind inside it. A locked 00000 here would declare the head office on a form whose filer must name a real branch, so the five cells stay editable. Widening 3 (or 4) compartments to 5 is the whole change; nothing is pre-filled.
layout_policy.chrome: each digit group: one outer 0.72pt frame, white knockout inside. Interior ticks are short bottom hairs (~33% of slot height), matching the official charbox (2550M month v172), not a full-height wall on every digit. Separators: dedicated SVG fill + 0.72pt black frame, no input, not in tab order.

reason: BIR's January-2010 artwork for the 1600WP attachment sheet is CORRECT and OUT OF DATE. It prints four compartments for the withholding agent's TIN branch code and prints nothing inside them. A Philippine TIN is 3-3-3-5, so a five-character branch code cannot be entered on four compartments. No rule can derive that width from 2010 ink, which is precisely why this is a stage-2 correction and not a stage-1 producer bug (ARCHITECTURE.md, 'What belongs in which stage'): the stage-1 emission reproduces the printed topology to 0.011pt and is not misreading anything.

filing_safety.harm: The page of the alphabetical list of payees is bound to the wrong branch of the withholding agent, or to no branch. This header is the only place the attachment sheet identifies whose withholding the listed payees belong to; if the branch code cannot be entered in full, the schedule is filed under a truncated code and the payees are attributed to a branch that did not withhold from them.
filing_safety.who_is_affected: Every 1600WP withholding agent whose branch code is five characters and who files the alphabetical-list attachment. They have no way to enter the fifth character on today's sheet.
filing_safety.today: Four compartments, all four typeable, nothing pre-printed in them: the filer can enter at most four characters.
filing_safety.after: Five compartments over the same printed box; a five-character branch code becomes enterable, at the cost of the emitted compartments no longer lining up with the four BIR printed.
